correctness.rationale: The law fiber follows from a full-rank proper-subset product-moment linear system; positive probabilities constrain exactly one parameter. Loss linear terms retain fixed expectations; repeated calculus gives Delta_n=(-1)^(n-1)(n-1)! times the strictly positive integral of the product of softmax probabilities. Thus unique endpoint optimality and label independence hold for every allowed n, K, logits, bins and marginals. Fair-parity and h/2^n asymptotic are exact binomial-difference consequences. The standalone checker executed 4283 checks, including 100 LPs; finite tests are supplementary, not infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The novelty claim is restricted to the exact softmax objective over a pre-existing (n-1)-wise-independent probability fiber: a strict all-order mixed derivative selects a single label-universal optimal coupling, with an exact nonperturbative loss gap. The feasibility fiber and the even-parity construction themselves are explicitly credited to Natarajan–Ramachandra–Tan (2022). Primary softmax-rounding work treats second-order Fisher and fresh operation-level randomness, not optimized moment-preserving joint output rounding. Searches identified no directly covering theorem. An unindexed higher-order dependence ordering specialized to softmax could dominate the result and remains an acknowledged priority risk.
residual_risks: Generic higher-order supermodular-order or dependence-optimality theorems not indexed by direct softmax terms might already imply the strict sign application.
The 2023 SIAM article and Manchester preprint were compared through abstracts/metadata, not fully read PDFs.
A one-shot output-logit rounding result cannot be transferred to sequential stochastic-rounding computations without checking conditional unbiasedness.

value.rationale: Moment-preserving stochastic rounding of multiple logits is motivated by modern low-precision softmax inference. The theorem identifies the globally optimal full-order coupling for exact expected cross entropy, uniformly across labels and arbitrary bin widths, and exhibits a nonperturbative gap unobservable to mean-covariance Fisher surrogates. The exact positive n=3 gain at finite width and asymptotic h/2^n benchmark have substantive calibration value; neither sequential arithmetic improvement nor deployed-model accuracy is claimed.
